jobs.description:
Software Development Internship & Training Program

**Company:** Zenvy Solutions  
**Program Type:** Training + Performance-Based Internship  
**Duration:** 3 Months

About the Program

Zenvy Solutions offers a structured Software Development Internship & Training Program designed for students, freshers, and aspiring developers who want to build technical skills and gain practical experience in software development.

The program begins with intensive technical training, followed by a practical project and internship phase based on the participant's learning progress, performance, and eligibility.

Program Structure

**Phase 1 – Technical Training (First 1.5 Months)**

Participants will undergo structured training covering:

* Software Development Fundamentals
* Frontend Development
* Backend Development Basics
* Database Integration
* Git & GitHub
* Project Development Fundamentals
* Practical Coding Exercises

**Phase 2 – Project & Internship Phase (Next 1.5 Months)**

After completing the initial training phase, participants will be evaluated based on their performance, technical skills, learning progress, task completion, and overall involvement.

Candidates who meet the required performance criteria will be eligible to proceed to the internship/project phase.

Eligible participants may receive a **stipend during the internship phase**, based on their performance and the program's eligibility criteria.

What You Will Gain

* Structured technical training
* Hands-on coding
